title: Guava Panna
subtitle: Guava simmered with sugar and a little chili into a sweet-spicy concentrate, served over ice with lime.
protein: A cooler, not a protein source

method.title: Cook the guava
items: Cover and cook on medium until the guavas turn soft and cooked through, 15–20 min
Stir once or twice so the sugar doesn't catch at the bottom

method.label: Toddler — keep her share (before the chilies)
items: Scoop {=2 tbsp} of the soft guava and syrup and press it through a sieve to remove the hard seeds
Keep it in a small jar; to serve, stir {=1 tbsp} into {=½ cup} of cool water — no masala, no ice

method.title: Grind the panna
items: Add {@red-chilies} to the kadai; simmer 2–3 min more
Take it off the flame and let it cool
Transfer to a grinder jar, add {@degi-chili} and grind to a smooth puree
Refrigerate in a clean jar; it keeps about a week

method.title: Serve
items: In a tall glass, take a spoonful (about {=2 tbsp}) of guava panna; add {@lime} and {@ice}

method.label: Tip
method.text: The dry red chilies used to cook with the guava from the start; they now go in after her share is scooped. For a silkier drink, push the adult puree through a sieve too — guava seeds are hard. Part of Chef Ranveer Brar's panna trio, with aam panna and pineapple panna. Stovetop kadai for the covered simmer, then a blender.
